arguments.analyst: Observations show bright singles/doubles around 3.8-3.87 (O1, O2, O3) and collapses to ~1.3 with certain pairs (O4, O5, O7), while O9 (F130L:H139R) sits mid. Conservative menu edits likely stay near 3.6, with risk from proline-like or clustered disruptive edits.
arguments.hypothesis: Doubles combining one benign conservative substitution with a residue-2-style surface change retain high log brightness (~3.6+), whereas pairs introducing helix-breaking or charge-cluster changes drop sharply; thus O1/O2-style context (D117G, E95-family) supports high values while O4/O5 proline pairs do not.

decision.analyst: Observations show bright singles/doubles around 3.8-3.87 (O1, O2, O3) and collapses to ~1.3 with certain pairs (O4, O5, O7), while O9 (F130L:H139R) sits mid. Conservative menu edits likely stay near 3.6, with risk from proline-like or clustered disruptive edits.
decision.hypothesis: Doubles combining one benign conservative substitution with a residue-2-style surface change retain high log brightness (~3.6+), whereas pairs introducing helix-breaking or charge-cluster changes drop sharply; thus O1/O2-style context (D117G, E95-family) supports high values while O4/O5 proline pairs do not.
decision.critic: Predictions cluster near 3.59 with overlapping uncertainty; none resolve O1/O2-style brightness gains, so ordering is weakly discriminative.
decision.selection_rationale: C32 highest estimate (3.608), then C01, C31, C41, C11; all conservative, so priority tests tight prediction spread and D117G/H148R context.
